maddeler.e:
ننقشع (form VII)
# نَنْقَشِعُ (nanqašiʕu) /nan.qa.ʃi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
# نَنْقَشِعَ (nanqašiʕa) /nan.qa.ʃi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
# نَنْقَشِعْ (nanqašiʕ) /nan.qa.ʃiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
